item.title: Google Gemini Phone Automation App List Leaks Covering 134 Apps
item.description:
Google's Gemini task automation app whitelist has surfaced, covering 114 apps on stable Android 17 QPR2 and 20 more on Android Canary for a total of 134, spanning food delivery, ride-hailing, shopping, travel and office scenarios. Gemini operates apps on a virtual screen and pauses before checkout for user confirmation, but whitelist inclusion does not mean automation is live, as Word and Outlook tests still failed to execute actions.

原文标题：谷歌 Gemini 手机自动化应用名单曝光 覆盖 134 款应用

Why it matters：这是手机端智能体从问答走向代操作的关键落地信号，白名单机制与实测边界对关注 Agent 落地的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Cerebras Signs Microsoft as Third Hyperscaler Customer
item.description:
Cerebras announced at its Q3 2026 earnings call that it has signed Microsoft as its third hyperscaler customer after AWS and Oracle. Quarterly core revenue reached about $230M with cloud services up 272% year over year, while remaining performance obligations hit $26.1B as of September 30 and 700MW of data center capacity is secured for 2027 delivery.

原文标题：Cerebras 签约微软 剩余履约义务达 261 亿美元

Why it matters：晶圆级芯片厂商拿下第三家超大规模云客户，261 亿美元剩余履约义务与 700MW 产能锁定是算力供给侧的重要信号。

item.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Sheets for Agent-Driven Spreadsheet Control
item.description:
Anthropic released Claude Sheets, giving agents more direct control over spreadsheets, while Google used Gemini 4 Hydrogen to paint and animate thousands of cells frame by frame in Google Sheets; Microsoft Office 365 remained down at the same time. The contrast highlights divergent spreadsheet strategies across the three vendors.

原文标题：Anthropic 发布 Claude Sheets 支持 Agent 操作表格

Why it matters：涉及 Agent 操作表格的新工具与 Google 的表格生成演示，具备一定工具生态参考价值。

item.title: Guoxing Aerospace Rolls Out Five Compute Satellites for 2800-Satellite Constellation
item.description:
Guoxing Aerospace's Star-Compute program has completed five satellites for its third batch at its Taizhou, Zhejiang facility, with launch expected soon; they will join batches 01 and 02 already in orbit. The long-term plan targets a 2,800-satellite space-based compute network, following the May 2025 launch of batch 01, billed as the world's first space computing constellation.

原文标题：国星宇航 5 颗算力卫星下线 目标 2800 颗组网

Why it matters：天基算力基础设施进入批量组网阶段，是算力供给形态外延的重要产业信号。

item.title: PharmA2A Launches First A2A-Based Pharmacy Procurement Protocol
item.description:
PharmA2A v0.1, released on 12 November, is the first sector-specific dictionary built on the Linux Foundation's A2A protocol, defining five JSON Schema messages for direct orders between pharmacy and supplier agents. It aims to automate the form, email and phone ordering workflow that French pharmacies run across hundreds of suppliers, while letting suppliers learn shelf-level product performance with pharmacist consent. The project is open source on GitHub and its author is soliciting real-world A2A deployment experience.

原文标题：PharmA2A 发布首个基于 A2A 的药房采购协议

Why it matters：这是 A2A 协议在垂直行业落地的早期样本，对关注智能体互操作标准的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic IPO Six Times Oversubscribed at $1.4 Trillion Valuation Target
item.description:
Anthropic's IPO is roughly six times oversubscribed, with the company and co-founders seeking up to $64.4 billion plus a $26 billion concurrent private placement, for up to $90.4 billion combined at a target fully diluted valuation of about $1.4 trillion. Nvidia plans to subscribe roughly $10 billion in the private placement, and underwriters say existing investors will be prioritized. Filings show a revenue run rate of $81 billion as of October 31, up $10 billion from late September.

原文标题：Anthropic IPO 认购超额 6 倍 目标估值 1.4 万亿美元

Why it matters：这是 AI 头部公司资本化进程的关键节点，募资规模、估值与认购热度均属行业量级事件。

item.title: DJI to Raise Suggested Retail Prices on Some Products from November 18
item.description:
DJI said on its official website that it will adjust suggested retail prices for some products starting 00:00 on November 18, 2026, citing sustained sharp increases in the cost of key components such as global semiconductors and memory; specific models and prices will be listed on its official store pages. IDC data shows DJI held 73% of global handheld smart camera shipments in Q2 2026, up 87% year on year.

原文标题：大疆宣布 11 月 18 日起上调部分产品售价

Why it matters：存储与半导体涨价传导至消费级硬件定价，是观察 AI 与智能硬件供应链成本压力的一个具体信号。

item.title: Rust 1.100 Ships With Never Type Stabilized After a Decade
item.description:
Rust 1.100.0 has shipped, marking the first three-digit release. The headline change is the long-awaited stabilization of the never type (!) after roughly a decade and five attempts, alongside core Allocator API stabilization, new standard-library items such as DropGuard and conjure_zst, and Cargo improvements for unused-dependency warnings and supply-chain security.

原文标题：Rust 1.100 发布 永不返回类型历经 10 年终稳定

Why it matters：Rust 语言层面的里程碑式版本，never type 与 Allocator API 稳定化对系统级开发者有实质影响。

item.title: ArtCraft Clones 17 Software Tools and Open Sources Them
item.description:
At the AI Engineer Code Summit, ArtCraft presented an AI-driven open source software rebuilding effort, having released 17 open source versions of popular tools, starting with PhotoCraft, a from-scratch Rust Photoshop alternative, and PdfCraft as an Acrobat clone. Founder Brandon Thomas framed it as a manifesto for AI-era open source, where agents do the bulk of development work while a human contributor community grows.

原文标题：ArtCraft 用 AI 复刻 17 款软件并开源

Why it matters：以智能体批量复刻并开源主流商业软件，展示了 AI 原生开源协作的新范式。

item.title: Hikrobot Completes Shareholding Reform and IPO Tutoring Filing
item.description:
Hikvision confirmed on its investor interaction platform that subsidiary Hikrobot has completed its shareholding reform and IPO tutoring filing, moving its listing process into a substantive phase. Hikrobot focuses on machine vision and mobile robots, with cumulative mobile robot output surpassing 200,000 units and more than 20,000 customers served.

原文标题：海康机器人完成股改与上市辅导备案

Why it matters：具身智能与工业机器人赛道的头部玩家启动 IPO，是观察机器人产业资本化节奏的重要信号。

item.title: Microsoft 365 Outage Drags Past 10 Hours, Japan Government Falls Back on Phones
item.description:
Microsoft's core Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook and Teams, suffered a global outage lasting over 10 hours without full recovery. Microsoft ruled out a traffic surge and traced the failure to a large number of servers failing automated health checks and being marked offline, overloading the remaining capacity. Japan's GSS government platform was affected, forcing agencies to fall back on phones and chat tools, while connection components relied on by OpenAI and Anthropic were also impacted.

原文标题：微软 365 全球宕机超 10 小时，日本政府改用电话维持运作

Why it matters：头部云办公基础设施的长时间全球性失效，暴露自动健康检查与流量调配的单点脆弱性，对依赖其服务的企业与 AI 应用有直接警示价值。

item.title: Samsung in Talks to Acquire Data Center Cooling Firm Modine
item.description:
Samsung Electronics is in talks to acquire US-based data center cooling systems maker Modine, with a deal potentially landing within weeks; Modine's market value stands at roughly $5.64 billion. The move follows Samsung's acquisition of FläktGroup and a KRW 240 billion capacity investment, extending its push into AI data center thermal management, though talks remain non-final and could still fall through.

原文标题：三星电子洽谈收购数据中心散热企业 Modine

Why it matters：三星围绕 AI 数据中心散热连续出手，反映算力基础设施热管理正成为大厂并购焦点。

item.title: Qijing GT7 Gets Largest OTA Update with Huawei ADS 5.0.2
item.description:
Qijing, the premium EV brand jointly built by GAC and Huawei, has rolled out its largest OTA since launch for its first model, the GT7. The update centers on Huawei's Qiankun ADS 5.0.2, adding gesture-based parking exit, campus navigation, lane-level guidance and active wading detection, alongside HarmonySpace 6 cockpit upgrades and battery fast-charging and thermal-management improvements.

原文标题：启境 GT7 推送华为乾崑 ADS 5.0.2 最大规模 OTA

Why it matters：这是华为乾崑智驾在量产车型上的一次较大规模功能推送，对关注智驾落地节奏的读者有参考价值。

Anthropic removed a Claude Code feature that developers had already built workflows around, without prior notice or deprecation warning. The incident highlights growing concerns over platform stability and backward compatibility in vendor-controlled agentic coding tools.

item.title: Brave Search API Adds x402 Agentic Pay-Per-Request Payments
item.description:
Brave Search API now supports the open x402 payment protocol, letting developers and autonomous AI agents pay per request in USDC against its independent search index without accounts or API keys. Brave runs its own facilitator settling on Base, with more chains and stablecoins planned.

原文标题：Brave 搜索 API 接入 x402 支持智能体即时付费

Why it matters：搜索基础设施首次原生支持智能体按次付费，为 Agent 自主调用外部工具提供了免账号的支付范式。

item.title: Axelera Unveils Titania Data Center AIPU Architecture for 2027
item.description:
Dutch chip startup Axelera AI has disclosed the architecture of Titania, its third-generation AIPU targeting data center inference, with mass production slated for Q3 2027 and over $300 million in orders already booked. Optimized for sparse MoE models, the chip delivers 2.5 PFLOPS at FP8, and a single 4U eight-card server can run a 1.6T MoE model locally, with the company claiming 7x per-watt throughput versus current data center servers.

原文标题：Axelera 公布数据中心 AIPU 芯片 Titania 架构

Why it matters：数据中心推理芯片赛道再添新玩家，Titania 以稀疏 MoE 优化和超高能效比直指英伟达，值得关注算力格局变化。

item.title: MiniMax H3-Image Tops Open Multi-Image Edit Arena with 10-Second 4K Generation
item.description:
MiniMax released H3-Image, an open-weight image model that ranks #1 among open models on the Multi-Image Edit Arena with a score of 1365, placing #11 overall and tying Nano Banana 2 and Pro as the only open model in the top 20. It supports 16-megapixel resolution and up to 16 reference images, with 2K editing in 10-15 seconds, which the lab claims is 3x faster than Nano Banana 2.1.

原文标题：MiniMax H3-Image 登顶开源多图编辑榜 10 秒生成 4K

Why it matters：开源图像模型首次在多图编辑榜逼近闭源前沿，且速度与分辨率指标明确，对关注开源多模态生态的读者有实质参考价值。

item.title: SMIC Warns Chip Foundry Capacity Will Tighten Sharply by 2027
item.description:
SMIC co-CEO Zhao Haijun said at the company's Q3 2026 earnings call that AI compute demand far outstrips supply, with industry consensus pointing to severe foundry capacity shortages in 2027 lasting into mid-to-late 2028. SMIC expects full-year revenue above $12 billion, up nearly 30% year over year, while shifting capacity freed from weak handset and low-end consumer orders toward specialty memory and BCD products.

原文标题：中芯国际预警 2027 年代工产能极度紧缺

Why it matters：头部代工厂 CEO 给出明确的 AI 算力供需时间表，是判断 2027 至 2028 年芯片产能与成本走势的一手产业信号。

item.title: JNTC Breaks Hoya Monopoly to Supply Seagate Glass Substrates from 2027
item.description:
South Korea's JNTC has completed construction of its Vietnam production line for HDD glass substrates and is expected to begin shipping to Seagate in Q1 2027, ramping in Q2 and covering roughly 40% of Seagate's glass substrate demand. Glass platters are essential for HAMR drives and were previously monopolized by Japan's Hoya, so a second supplier could ease the HAMR capacity bottleneck and support areal-density-driven capacity growth.

原文标题：JNTC 打破豪雅垄断 2027 年起向希捷供应玻璃盘片

Why it matters：存储供应链关键材料打破单一垄断，直接关系 HAMR 机械硬盘产能与 AI 数据存储成本。

item.title: NYC Council Passes Ban on Algorithmic Surveillance Pricing
item.description:
The New York City Council passed a bill banning surveillance pricing, which sets prices based on algorithms or shoppers' personal data such as demographics, credit, browsing and purchase history. The ban covers both online and in-store transactions and directly constrains personalized pricing strategies used by e-commerce and retail firms.

原文标题：纽约市议会通过算法定价禁令

Why it matters：这是算法定价首次遭遇城市级立法禁令，对依赖用户数据做动态定价的 AI 商业应用具有直接合规影响。

item.title: Rapidus May Delay 2nm Mass Production to Fiscal 2028
item.description:
Japan's Jiji Press reports that Rapidus is considering pushing back mass production of its 2nm logic process by one year to fiscal 2028. The company began 2nm transistor trial production in 2025 but has hit integration hurdles between transistors and other components, falling short of performance targets while working to improve yields.

原文标题：Rapidus 或推迟 2nm 量产至 2028 财年

Why it matters：日本先进制程国家队量产节点生变，直接影响全球 2nm 代工竞争格局与日本半导体复兴时间表。

雷鸟创新双 11 期间在京东、天猫、抖音三平台总成交额突破 1 亿元，全平台销量市占率达 37.2%，连续 5 年蝉联品类销量第一。公司同时宣布品牌累计出货量突破 100 万台，成为继 Meta 之后全球第二家完成百万出货的智能眼镜品牌。

item.description:
中芯国际第三季度销售收入达 31.9 亿美元，环比增长 6.1%，超出指引上限，主因客户对 BCD、专用存储、Controller 等 AI 配套芯片的提拉速度快于预期。平均晶圆单价环比提升 1.8%，公司预计全年收入超 120 亿美元、同比增长近三成，但设备交付周期拉长可能扰动明年资本开支执行。

item.title: MIT 与 Meta 提出智能体记忆纠错新方法
item.description:
MIT 与 Meta 联合论文提出 ReHarness 机制，让智能体在每次任务结束后，用任务结果反向修订此前被检索复用的旧笔记，而非只追加新笔记，从而避免过时或过宽的教训持续误导智能体。在 3 个基准与 3 个前沿模型上，该方法平均取得 0.240 的归一化增益，优于最佳原始轨迹基线的 0.168；在 CL-Bench 上配合 Claude 时，其 token 消耗仅为回放完整原始历史的约三分之一。

Why it matters：针对智能体经验记忆易过时这一真实痛点给出可复用方法，并有跨模型跨基准的量化对比。

item.title: 芝加哥学区拒绝谷歌捆绑 AI 宁可弃用搜索
item.description:
谷歌教育业务负责人此前表示，K-12 学校须接受其 AI 服务才能保留学生使用搜索的权限，理由是搜索与 AI 已深度整合。芝加哥公立学校明确回应将改用其他搜索方案，并引发针对谷歌的抗议活动。这一事件凸显教育机构对强制捆绑 AI 的抵触，以及大厂以核心产品为筹码推动 AI 渗透的争议路径。

Why it matters：大厂以搜索为筹码强制推广 AI 遭学区公开抵制，是观察 AI 落地阻力与渠道博弈的典型样本。
